Market today: The mood in tech and chips is mixed. AI continues to drive sky-high valuations in some names, but there's real uncertainty if the recent chip stock rebound is sustainable after a violent selloff. This means continued volatility for your concentrated book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-80.16%), MUU (-63.75%), and SPAL (-50.98%) are in dire straits. These are leveraged ETFs, meaning they decay over time and their drops are amplified, especially on margin. Your default stops are not active, so these need immediate attention.

Watch: Keep a close eye on whether the chip stock rebound holds up or if the "violent selloff" resumes. Also, monitor the broader tech sector for signs of further decline or stabilization.

Bottom line: With so many "SELL" signals and deep losses in leveraged positions, risk management and capital preservation are your top priorities.
plays: Trim SOXL, MUU, SPAL: These leveraged ETFs are deep in the red and decay. Consider reducing exposure to manage margin risk.
Respect stops: QQQ (-8.14%) and SMH (-27.7%) are in 'SELL' status. Honor their stops to protect capital if they trigger.
Consider SQQQ: Scanner shows an 'ACCUMULATE' setup (entry 47.02-46.71, stop 45.6) as a potential hedge against further tech declines.
